sections.content: I am writing to express my keen interest in the Bioinformatics Research Engineer position within the Cloud AI Research team at Google, as advertised on your careers page (REF-2026-1234). The opportunity to apply machine learning and large-scale data analysis to biological problems aligns perfectly with my academic training and professional aspirations.

content: I am currently completing my Master's degree in Bioinformatics at Saarland University, where my research focuses on integrating multi-omics datasets — including metagenomics, transcriptomics, and proteomics — using computational pipelines built with Python, R, and Nextflow. My thesis work involves developing novel approaches for functional annotation of microbial communities using graph-based machine learning methods.

I hold a previous Master's degree in Biotechnology from the University of Tehran, where I developed expertise in molecular biology techniques and experimental design. This dual background gives me a unique perspective at the intersection of wet-lab biology and computational analysis.

sections.content: On the engineering side, I bring strong proficiency in Python and R for scientific computing, experience with cloud infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions), and hands-on practice with database systems including PostgreSQL and MongoDB. I have contributed to open-source bioinformatics tools and maintained production-grade data pipelines as a freelance full-stack developer.

Google's Cloud AI Research team's work on applying deep learning to protein structure prediction and genomic variant calling resonates strongly with my research interests. I am particularly drawn to the team's emphasis on scalable, reproducible analysis frameworks — an area where my experience building containerized bioinformatics workflows would be directly applicable.

I would be delighted to discuss how my interdisciplinary background in bioinformatics, software engineering, and biotechnology can contribute to your team's research goals. I am available for an interview at your convenience and could start as early as June 2026.
